title: Image space reservation
description: Images without dimensions or an equivalent reserved aspect ratio may cause shifts.
guidance: Inspect the actual layout; do not blindly lazy-load a prominent hero image.
verification: Run the supported static check and inspect its evidence; perform contextual or runtime verification where noted.
counterexamples: An intentional, appropriate project choice or existing verified control can make this concern inapplicable.

title: Font loading strategy
description: Web-font loading can delay content or cause shifts.
guidance: Choose font-display and preloading in the context of real loading behaviour.
verification: Run the supported static check and inspect its evidence; perform contextual or runtime verification where noted.
